name: FiveM (GTA V roleplay)
description: FiveM / Cfx.re server with txAdmin built in. The wizard walks you through your license key, framework and database — a full ESX or QBox roleplay server is a few clicks after the first boot.

wizard.title: Server basics
wizard.description: The name players see in the server browser, and how many of them can join.

wizard.title: Cfx.re license key
wizard.description: Every FiveM server needs a free license key. Open keymaster.fivem.net, sign in with your Cfx.re (Rockstar/Discord) account, click 'Generate a new key', choose 'Other' and any IP, then paste the key below. It looks like cfxk_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx_xxxxx.

wizard.title: Framework
wizard.description: txAdmin's recipe deployer installs ESX or QBox for you on first boot — including the database tables. Pick 'txAdmin' unless you know you want a bare server.

wizard.title: Database
wizard.description: ESX and QBox need MySQL. GamePanel can run a private MariaDB container alongside this server — nothing to install, and it is only reachable by this one server. Use host 'db', port 3306 when txAdmin asks.

variables.name: SERVER_TAGS
variables.label: Server tags
variables.description: Comma separated, shown in the server browser.

variables.name: LICENSE_KEY
variables.label: Cfx.re license key
variables.description: From keymaster.fivem.net — required before the server will accept players.

variables.name: FRAMEWORK
variables.label: Framework
variables.description: txadmin = guided ESX / QBox / vMenu deployment in the txAdmin web UI. vanilla = plain cfx-server-data, no framework.

variables.name: INSTALL_DATABASE
variables.label: Run a MariaDB container for this server
variables.description: Needed for ESX/QBox. Ignored when Docker is unavailable.

variables.name: FIVEM_BUILD
variables.label: Artifact build
variables.description: 'recommended' is the stable build Cfx.re advises for production.

install.label: Download the FiveM server artifacts
install.run:
CHANNEL="{{FIVEM_BUILD}}"
URL=$(curl -sf https://changelogs-live.fivem.net/api/changelog/versions/linux/server | node -e 'let d="";const want=process.argv[1];process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log(want==="latest"?j.latest_download:j.recommended_download);})' "$CHANNEL")
[ -n "$URL" ] || gp_die "Could not resolve the FiveM artifact download"
gp_log "Artifact: $URL"
mkdir -p artifacts
gp_fetch "$URL" fx.tar.xz
tar -xJf fx.tar.xz -C artifacts || gp_die "Could not unpack the artifacts"
rm -f fx.tar.xz
chmod +x artifacts/run.sh artifacts/FXServer 2>/dev/null || true

install.label: Fetch the base resources (cfx-server-data)
install.run:
if [ ! -d server-data/resources ]; then
  git clone --quiet --depth 1 https://github.com/citizenfx/cfx-server-data.git server-data || gp_die "Could not clone cfx-server-data"
  rm -rf server-data/.git
fi
mkdir -p server-data/resources/[local]
gp_log "Drop your own resources into server-data/resources — the file manager can upload and unzip them."

install.label: Write the server configuration
install.run:
if [ ! -f server-data/server.cfg ]; then
  cat > server-data/server.cfg <<'CFGEOF'
# Generated by GamePanel. Edit freely — it is never overwritten.
endpoint_add_tcp "0.0.0.0:{{PORT}}"
endpoint_add_udp "0.0.0.0:{{PORT}}"

ensure mapmanager
ensure chat
ensure spawnmanager
ensure sessionmanager
ensure basic-gamemode
ensure hardcap
ensure rconlog

sv_scriptHookAllowed 0
rcon_password "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}"
sv_hostname "{{SERVER_HOSTNAME}}"
sets tags "{{SERVER_TAGS}}"
sets locale "en-GB"
sv_maxclients {{MAX_PLAYERS}}
sv_licenseKey "{{LICENSE_KEY}}"

# MariaDB companion container (host 'db'), when enabled:
set mysql_connection_string "mysql://fivem:{{DB_PASSWORD}}@db/fivem?charset=utf8mb4"

add_ace group.admin command allow
add_ace group.admin command.quit deny
add_principal identifier.fivem:1 group.admin
CFGEOF
  gp_log "server-data/server.cfg written"
fi
if [ -z "{{LICENSE_KEY}}" ]; then
  gp_warn "No license key set yet — add it in Settings (LICENSE_KEY) or through txAdmin before going public."
fi

startCommand: if [ "{{FRAMEWORK}}" = "vanilla" ]; then cd server-data && exec ../artifacts/run.sh +exec server.cfg; else exec ./artifacts/run.sh +set txAdminPort {{PORT_TXADMIN}} +set serverProfile gamepanel; fi
